title: Surreal Mythic Landscape
description: A bearded man with horns and colorful headdress stands holding a sword beside a large patterned dog-like creature. They are positioned on broken stone ruins in a vibrant green valley with a reflective lake, under a giant dripping red moon in a swirling purple sky filled with bubbles containing animals.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a muscular bearded man with black horns and a large colorful feathered headdress standing on ancient stone ruins. He holds a sword and stands next to a large stylized blue and orange dog-like creature. Behind them is a serene lake reflecting a massive dripping blood-red moon in a swirling purple and pink cosmic sky. The rolling green hills are dotted with silhouetted figures wearing bright orange and pink headdresses. Transparent bubbles float throughout containing small animals like cats, dogs, and deer. White flowers grow among the broken stones in the foreground.
